name: cross-functional-review
description: Draft → multi-discipline review board → synthesized rewrite. Branches in the converge are distinct perspectives (product / UX / engineering) reading the SAME draft; a merger agent synthesizes their feedback, and the writer produces a final pass informed by it. Use when a piece of work is correct-in-isolation but needs sign-off from multiple disciplines before shipping.

phases.name: draft
phases.prompt:
Produce a first draft addressing the request below. Optimize for clarity over completeness — this is going to a review board next.

${input}

converge.name: product-perspective
ux-perspective
engineering-perspective

phases.name: final
